From the corrected value:
\[
2a_1=\frac{137-4753}{49}=\frac{-4616}{49}
\]
so
\[
a_1=-\frac{2308}{49}.
\]

The even-indexed terms form an arithmetic sequence with 49 terms, first term \(a_2=a_1+1\), and common difference 2. Thus
\[
a_2+a_4+\cdots+a_{98}
=\frac{49}{2}\left(2(a_1+1)+48\cdot 2\right)
=49(a_1+49).
\]

Substitute \(a_1=-\frac{2308}{49}\):
\[
49\left(-\frac{2308}{49}+49\right)
=49\left(\frac{93}{49}\right)
=93.
\]

\[
\boxed{93}
\]
